environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate tasks in an isolated private subnet (no NAT, no IGW route). Exposed exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 PrivateLink endpoint service. The VPC endpoint policy attached to the consumer-side interface endpoint restricts the principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/internal-service-caller only. The provider-side NLB target group health check validates the service is running but the NLB has no public-facing listener — it is internal-only (scheme: internal). Additionally, the ECS task role has no network interface modification permissions and the subnet's route table contains only local VPC routes (no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry). DNS resolution for the service endpoint resolves to private IPs within the 10.0.0.0/8 range only via the VPC endpoint's private DNS.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in isolated private subnet
config.network: No IGW, no NAT gateway, no public route in subnet route table
config.dns: Private DNS via VPC endpoint only, resolves to 10.x.x.x
config.ecs_task_networking: awsvpc mode, no public IP assignment, no ENI modification permissions
config.subnet_route_table: local routes only (10.0.0.0/16 -> local), no default route
